build: Modwerk's linker: the vendored core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Improved SMPL 0.5.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version SV02

emulator.name: rytm-emu

conditions: SETUP: a card holding one generated 23,777-frame ramp from -26,000 to +26,000 (RAMP.wav, dtcard add), then dtboot sv02.syx --card card.img --instr 14800M --every 1000M --press NO@2000M --press NO@2300M --press NO@2600M --press NO@2900M --press GLOBAL@3300M --press DOWN@5100M --press YES@5400M --press DOWN@5700M --press YES@6000M --press DOWN@6300M --press YES@6600M --press DOWN@6900M --press YES@7200M --press RIGHT@7500M --press DOWN@7800M --press DOWN@8100M --press YES@8400M --press YES@8700M --press NO@10100M --press NO@10300M --press NO@10500M --press NO@10700M --press SMPL@11000M --turn 3:6@11300Mx6/30M --press YES@11700M --turn 6:6@12500Mx6/30M --save setup.snap (BD on the ramp, LOP ON, SAMPLE page; the kit's FIN, now RATE, is +0). R63: dtboot sv02.syx --load setup.snap --instr 1000M --every 100M --midi bd197f@14900M --save r63.snap (CC 25 127 on the auto channel: RATE +63). Captured on SV02 on 12 Nov 2026 (the waveform view with one row of values over a taller waveform) in rytm-emu c5732f0. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
